app.name: MoneyQuest
app.tagline: Build your town. Master your money.
welcome.title: Welcome to MoneyQuest!
welcome.body: A town that grows as you learn how money works.
welcome.join: Join my family on this device
parent.setPin: Grown-ups: choose a 4-digit parent PIN. You'll use it to manage profiles and link other devices.
parent.pinMismatch: Those PINs don't match. Try again.
parent.privacy: MoneyQuest never asks for real names, emails or photos. No ads, no trackers, no real money.
join.title: Join a family
join.failed: Couldn't join. Check the code and PIN, and that you're online.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Remove {name}? Their progress will be deleted.
creator.title: Create your character
creator.step.name: Nickname
creator.nicknameHelp: Use a fun nickname, not your real name.
creator.nicknameBad: Please choose a different nickname (no real names, emails or numbers).
creator.buddy: Choose a guide to help you
creator.evolveNote: You and your guide will grow and get new looks as you level up!
town.hello: This is your town! Finish worlds to build it up.
town.tapBuilding: Tap a building to visit its world.
worlds.title: Worlds
lesson.sortTap: Tap an item, then tap where it goes.
lesson.quitConfirm: Leave this level? You can come back any time.
results.title: Level complete!
levelUp.title: Level up!
levelUp.evolve: You and your guide look even cooler now!
game.ready: Sort as many as you can before time runs out!
quests.title: Quests
quests.chestDone: Come back tomorrow for the next chest!
quests.chestCalendar: Chest calendar: every reward is shown up front.
quests.freezesHelp: A freeze keeps your streak safe if you miss a day. You earn one every 7 days.
quests.reviewNone: No skills to review right now. Learn a new lesson!
quests.lbEmpty: Add more family players to compare progress.
streak.frozen: A streak freeze kept your {n}-day streak safe!
streak.restarted: Welcome back! A fresh streak starts today.
trophies.title: Trophy room
shop.title: Town shop
shop.note: Everything here is bought with coins and gems you earn by playing. No real money, ever.
shop.notEnough: Not enough yet. Keep playing to earn more!
settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: Nicknames only. No ads, no trackers, no chat with strangers, no real money. Progress is saved on this device and backed up to your family account.
break.title: Time for a break?
break.body: You've been playing for {n} minutes. Stretch, drink some water, or tell someone what you learned!
review.title: Practice review
review.bonus: Spaced practice makes skills stick. Bonus coins earned!
error.generic: Oops! Something went wrong. Your progress is safe.
offline.banner: Playing offline. Progress is saved on this device.
lesson.reveal: No problem! Here's how it works:
journey.title: {city} Money Journey
journey.intro: Travel across {city}! At every stop your guide explains, and you answer questions to move on.
bank.title: {bank}
bank.intro: Save coins here and they grow by {rate}% every week. That's compound interest: next week you earn interest on your interest too!
bank.projection: Leave {n} saved for 8 weeks and it grows to about {m}.
bank.gemsHelp: Gems unlock special items. 1 gem = {price} coins you earned.
bank.noRealMoney: Coins are only earned by answering and playing. Nothing here costs real money.
earn.tip: Answer right the first time to earn more. Keep a streak going for bonus coins!
partner.note: Children learn how banking works here. Choosing a real account is always a grown-up decision.
creator.cityHelp: Your journey, money, prices and stories will match this city.
sim.goalTodo: Keep adjusting to reach the goal.
